newsitem.title: USA: Perini gets $280 mln contract for hotel.
newsitem.headline: Perini gets $280 mln contract for hotel.

text.p: Perini Corp said on Wednesday its western U.S. division was awarded a $280 million contract to build a new 29-level hotel tower, with a Roman theme, for ITT Corp's Caesars Palace in Las Vegas, Nevada.

Perini said this was largest single building contract it was ever awarded. The hotel would contain 1,132 guest rooms and 49 suites, a convention area, meeting rooms, ballrooms, and a complete spa and fitness facility.
Construction was underway and the project was expected to be completed in December 1997, Perini said.
The company said the value of the contract was included in its third quarter 1996 backlog of $1.746 billion announced on November 13.
Work on the project also included the construction of a new pool with special features and extensive landscaping, te company said.
